# witness: do
# description: Divinum Officium project, Ordo Missae — Psalm 25, 6-12 with
#   the Glória Patri, said at the washing of the fingers
# source: https://github.com/divinumofficium/divinum-officium
# path: web/www/missa/Latin/Ordo/Ordo.txt (lines 182-186, 23-24)
# fetched: 2026-08-05 (master; byte-identical to the raw file archived at
#   ../raw/do-ordo-missae.txt)
# orthography: 1962 liturgical (j, æ-ligature incl. accented ǽ, accents)
# note: versicle marker (v.) stripped; the psalm reference line "Ps. 25,
#   6-12" is edition framing, not text, and so is the conditional marker
#   before the doxology, which records that the Glória Patri is omitted in
#   Masses for the Dead. This edition does not print the doxology at this
#   place but refers to its own shared block (&Gloria); it is expanded here
#   from the same file's own setting of the Glória Patri at the Júdica me
#   (lines 23-24), and that expansion is the whole of the difference between
#   this transcription and the lines as they stand. Prints circúmdabo, no
#   comma after the first tuæ and none after me (all adjudicated in the
#   apparatus)
Lavábo inter innocéntes manus meas: et circúmdabo altáre tuum, Dómine: Ut áudiam vocem laudis, et enárrem univérsa mirabília tua. Dómine, diléxi decórem domus tuæ et locum habitatiónis glóriæ tuæ. Ne perdas cum ímpiis, Deus, ánimam meam, et cum viris sánguinum vitam meam: In quorum mánibus iniquitátes sunt: déxtera eórum repléta est munéribus. Ego autem in innocéntia mea ingréssus sum: rédime me et miserére mei. Pes meus stetit in dirécto: in ecclésiis benedícam te, Dómine. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper: et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
